title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect (Presales)
description:
- Description

  You will lead the technical solutioning for Dynamics 365 CRM deals. You will design solutions across the Dynamics apps and Power Platform, present them to clients, and help us close projects.

  Responsibilities

  * Run discovery workshops and convert business needs into a Dynamics 365 solution
  * Design architecture across Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Marketing (Customer Insights – Journeys), and Customer Insights – Data
  * Use Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio) to extend the solution
  * Plan the Dataverse data model, security roles, environments, and ALM strategy
  * Design integrations with Azure services, Microsoft 365, Teams, ERP (including Finance & Operations / Business Central), and third-party systems
  * Deliver demos and POCs that show clear business value
  * Prepare solution documents, estimates, licensing recommendations, SOWs, and RFP responses
  * Suggest AI ideas using Copilot and Azure AI to improve productivity and customer experience
  * Support sales on pricing, licensing, and negotiation, and hand over to delivery with a clear plan

  Required Skills

  * Strong hands-on experience in at least 2 or 3 Dynamics 365 CRM apps
  * Good knowledge of Dataverse, plugins, custom workflows, PCF, and Power Platform
  * Experience in data migration, integration patterns, and performance tuning
  * Understanding of Microsoft licensing for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform
  * Experience with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and Service Bus
  * Excellent communication and executive presentation skills

  **Good to Have**

  * Industry experience in areas like manufacturing, BFSI, public sector, or retail
  * Experience with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or Business Central
  * Experience working with a Microsoft partner

  **Certifications**

  * Must: PL-600 (Power Platform Solution Architect), or at least 2 of MB-210, MB-230, MB-240, MB-280, or PL-200
  * Plus: AI-related Microsoft certifications (AI-900, AI-102

  **What Success Looks Like:**

  Consistent deal wins, correct licensing and estimates, and a smooth transition to delivery.

title: Salesforce Solution Architect (Presales)
description:
- Description

  You will lead the technical side of our sales process for Salesforce projects. You will understand the client's business problem, design the right solution across Salesforce clouds, and help us win and close the deal with a clear, realistic plan.

  Responsibilities

  * Join discovery calls, understand client pain points, and turn them into a clear Salesforce solution
  * Design end-to-end architecture across Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience, Commerce, CPQ/Revenue, Data Cloud, and Agentforce
  * Run product demos and proof of concepts (POCs) tailored to the client's use case
  * Prepare solution documents, architecture diagrams, effort estimates, and SOWs
  * Respond to RFPs and RFIs with strong technical and commercial answers
  * Present to CXOs, IT heads, and business teams, and handle objections with confidence
  * Work with the sales team on deal strategy, pricing, and timelines
  * Suggest new ideas, such as AI, automation, and data unification, that add value beyond the original ask
  * Hand over cleanly to the delivery team and support the project in the first phase

  Required Skills

  * Strong hands-on knowledge of at least 2 or 3 Salesforce clouds and good working knowledge of the rest
  * Solid understanding of data model, security model, integration patterns, and governance
  * Experience with APIs, MuleSoft or similar middleware, and ERP/third-party integrations
  * Knowledge of Apex, LWC, Flows, and the limits of the platform
  * Experience with data migration and org strategy (multi-org vs single-org)
  * Excellent communication, demo, and storytelling skills

  **Good to Have**

  * Industry experience (BFSI, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, etc.)
  * Tableau / CRM Analytics, Slack, Field Service
  * Experience working with a Salesforce partner or SI

  **Certifications**

  * Must: Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect, or at least 2 consultant certifications
  * Plus: Data Cloud, Agentforce, or Marketing Cloud certifications

  **What Success Looks Like** : a good win rate on qualified deals, accurate estimates, and smooth handover to delivery

title: Blazor Technical Lead / .NET Solution Architect
description:

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience modernizing legacy ASP.NET Web Forms applications.
* Healthcare/EHR application experience.
* Experience designing high-concurrency enterprise applications and scalable systems.

title: Lead – Digital Transformation, AI & Business Automation
description:
Key Responsibilities

**A. Digital Transformation & ERP/CRM Integration**

* Design and execute the roadmap for LAXMI ONE, an integrated operating platform for the Group.
* Integrate existing applications such as Buildesk CRM, TallyPrime, Zoho People, WhatsApp, websites, and other approved platforms wherever technically and commercially practical.
* Develop APIs, middleware, database integrations, and automated data flows to establish a central source of truth.
* Reduce duplicate data entry, disconnected systems, manual reporting, and repetitive administrative work.
* Develop and implement modules progressively based on business priorities.

**B. Business Process Automation**

* Study existing workflows across departments and identify bottlenecks, manual activities, control gaps, and automation opportunities.
* Convert business policies into documented workflows, task assignments, approval matrices, checklists, deadlines, and escalation rules.
* Automate task allocation, reminders, approvals, follow-ups, reporting, and exception escalation.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and tracking for every critical business process.

**C. AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Implement suitable AI and LLM-based solutions for document processing, data analysis, reporting, business assistance, and workflow automation.
* Develop AI-assisted monitoring to identify delays, pending tasks, deviations, unusual transactions, and performance gaps.
* Build automated alerts and exception-based dashboards for management.
* Ensure human approval for sensitive decisions, financial transactions, legal matters, and other high-impact actions.
* Evaluate emerging AI tools and automation platforms for practical business use.

**D. Department-Wise Digital Systems**

Develop, integrate, or automate workflows across the following business functions:

* **Sales & Customer Management:** CRM, lead management, pre-sales, post-sales, customer/member records, booking, allotment, collections, demand letters, and possession.
* **Marketing:** Digital marketing workflows, campaign reporting, lead attribution, and performance dashboards.
* **Finance & Accounts:** TallyPrime integration, budgeting, billing, MIS, GST workflows, bank reconciliation, cash-flow monitoring, and project finance reporting.
* **Construction & Projects:** Project planning, construction timelines, bar charts, manpower planning, site expenses, labour attendance, productivity, quality, safety, and insurance tracking.
* **Purchase & Inventory:** Purchase requests, quotation comparison, approvals, inventory, material movement, and vendor management.
* **Contracts & Legal:** Contractor, architect, structural, MEP and consultant contracts; contract-linked billing; legal documentation; land records; title, valuation, agreements, and court-case tracking.
* **Compliance & Corporate Governance:** RERA, statutory compliance, Company Secretary workflows, Board and Committee meetings, Independent Director requirements, stock exchange and SEBI compliance tracking, as applicable.
* **HR & People Management:** Zoho People integration, attendance, employee records, designation, job descriptions, KPIs, targets, performance reviews, increments, promotions, rewards, training, and growth paths.
* **Hospitality & Member Services:** Member management, hospitality systems, mobile applications, and future e-commerce requirements.
* **Management Reporting:** Department-wise dashboards, project-wise performance, Group-level MIS, planning, and goal tracking.

**E. Workflow, Accountability & Control Framework**

Implement a standard workflow framework:

**Trigger → Task → Responsible Person → Deadline → Checklist → Evidence/Document → Approval → Completion → AI Review → Escalation → Dashboard**

Ensure that every employee and critical business activity can be mapped to the relevant designation, job description, authority, reporting manager, KPI, target, tasks, deadlines, achievements, pending work, training, and growth path.

**F. Dashboards, MIS & Planning**

* Develop real-time or scheduled dashboards for management and department heads.
* Establish exception-based reporting instead of depending on manual follow-ups.
* Support weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, 3-year, 5-year, and 10-year planning and goal tracking.
* Define data ownership, validation rules, audit trails, and reporting standards.

**G. Data Security & System Governance**

* Implement role-based access control, data privacy, backup, recovery, and cybersecurity practices.
* Maintain reliable records, integration logs, and audit trails.
* Ensure secure handling of employee, customer, financial, legal, and confidential business data.
* Document system architecture, APIs, workflows, configurations, and technical processes.

3. Required Technical Skills

* Strong practical experience in full-stack development and business application development.
* Hands-on knowledge of relational databases, data modelling, SQL, and database architecture.
* Experience developing and integrating REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party applications.
* Understanding of ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, workflow engines, and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience with workflow automation, dashboards, reporting, and business intelligence.
* Practical exposure to AI/LLM integration, AI APIs, prompt engineering, and intelligent automation.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, role-based access, data security, and application deployment.
* Ability to evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and work with existing platforms wherever appropriate.
* Familiarity with Git, testing, documentation, deployment, and application maintenance.

4. Candidate Profile

* Approximately 5–8 years of relevant hands-on experience in software development, enterprise applications, ERP/CRM, SaaS, business automation, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience building or substantially developing real-world systems and integrations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with a business-process-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work directly with management, HR, Finance, Sales, Projects, Purchase, Legal, and other departments.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing organization and managing multiple implementation priorities.
* Capable of taking ownership from requirement gathering through development, implementation, testing, adoption, and continuous improvement.

Candidates with only website development, basic IT support, or theoretical AI knowledge without practical system-building experience may not be suitable.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against agreed implementation milestones, including:

* Successful integration of prioritized existing applications.
* Reduction in duplicate data entry and manual reporting.
* Number and quality of business workflows successfully automated.
* Accuracy, reliability, security, and adoption of implemented systems.
* Availability and usefulness of management dashboards.
* Reduction in pending tasks, process delays, and manual follow-ups.
* Successful implementation of AI-assisted alerts and exception reporting.
* Quality of documentation, system maintenance, and user training.
* Delivery of agreed project milestones within approved timelines and budgets.

Specific targets and timelines will be finalized with management after assessing the current technology environment and implementation priorities.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Job Description – E\-commerce Solution Architect**
====================================================

### **Role**

**E\-commerce Solution Architect / Technical Architect**### **Experience**

**12\+ years** of experience in software engineering, with strong experience in designing and architecting large\-scale e\-commerce applications.### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Solution Architect** to define and drive the technical architecture of a large\-scale e\-commerce platform. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, DevOps, QA, and business teams to design scalable, secure, highly available, and maintainable solutions.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **Java/Spring Boot, React, microservices, APIs, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, along with a solid understanding of modern e\-commerce architecture.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the **end\-to\-end architecture** for e\-commerce applications across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design scalable and highly available solutions using **Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and React**.
* Define frontend architecture and best practices using **React, TypeScript, state management, and reusable components**.
* Design cloud\-native solutions on **GCP**, considering scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost optimization.
* Work with engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Define architecture standards, design patterns, coding standards, and technology guidelines.
* Review technical designs, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability or performance issues.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to developers, leads, and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD, infrastructure, observability, monitoring, and deployment strategies.
* Ensure solutions follow security, compliance, and enterprise architecture standards.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve engineering productivity and application capabilities.
* Support troubleshooting of complex production issues and provide long\-term architectural solutions.

### **Technical Skills**

**Backend*** Java 11/17\+
* Spring Boot / Spring Framework
* Microservices architecture
* REST APIs
* Event\-driven architecture
* Kafka or similar messaging platforms
* Distributed systems and caching

**Frontend*** React
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* React\-based application architecture
* State management
* Responsive and reusable UI architecture
* Frontend performance optimization

**Cloud – GCP*** Strong hands\-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform**
* GKE / Kubernetes
* Cloud Run
* Cloud Functions
* API Gateway / Apigee
* Pub/Sub
* Cloud SQL / Spanner
* Cloud Storage
* IAM and security
* Cloud Load Balancing
* Monitoring and Logging
* VPC and networking
* Cloud\-native architecture and cost optimization

**DevOps \& Engineering*** GitHub / Git
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
* Automated testing
* Observability and application monitoring

### **E\-commerce Experience**


Strong experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:* Product catalog
* Search
* Pricing and promotions
* Cart and checkout
* Order management
* Payment integrations
* Inventory
* Customer/account management
* Personalization
* Store and e\-commerce integrations
* Third\-party integrations
* High\-volume transactional systems

### **Architecture \& Leadership**

* Strong understanding of **domain\-driven design (DDD)** and microservices.
* Experience designing **high\-volume, low\-latency distributed systems**.
* Strong understanding of API design and integration patterns.
* Experience with scalability, resilience, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
* Ability to make architecture decisions considering **performance, maintainability, security, and cost**.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with senior engineering and business stakeholders and clearly communicate complex technical concepts.
* Experience mentoring technical leads and senior engineers.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with **5\+ years in an Architect/Senior Architect role**.
* Experience architecting **large\-scale e\-commerce platforms**.
* Strong combination of **Java \+ React \+ GCP** experience.
* GCP certification is a plus.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience working with distributed/global engineering teams.

### **What We Are Looking For**


The ideal candidate is not just an architecture/documentation person. We are looking for someone who can **work closely with engineering teams, challenge technical decisions, review implementation, troubleshoot complex problems, and drive the architecture from design through production**.**Core Technology Stack:****React \| TypeScript \| Java \| Spring Boot \| Microservices \| REST \| Kafka/Pub/Sub \| GCP \| Kubernetes \| Docker \| GitHub \| CI/CD**
